{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:59.919
    | text      = Baptists and Catholic theologians find common ground.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.240

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:06.480
    | text      = Southern Baptists and Roman Catholics the nation's two largest denominations generally
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:10.940
    | text      = have been regarded as doctrinally far apart, but their scholars find they basically agree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:17.220
    | text      = The 163 page report is seen as the most full scale mutual examination of respective positions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:25.419

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:31.860

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:36.860
    | text      = Affairs and the Southern Baptist Department of Interfaith Witness involved eighteen meetings
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:41.740

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.740
    | text      = Again that appeared in the Bakersfield Californian August 27th 1989.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:48.980
    | text      = Now I want you to listen to me very carefully during this broadcast for the message tonight

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.220
    | text      = He's reading a news story about a report that came out of a series of meetings between Catholics
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.360
    | text      = and Southern Baptists over the span of ten years looking to find their similarities and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:24.820
    | text      = differences.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:25.980
    | text      = One might ask why these groups decided to sit down and examine their beliefs and one
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:29.799
    | text      = of the big drivers of it was that there was a real anti-Catholic sentiment in the United
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.200
    | text      = States.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:35.539
    | text      = Many of the colonists who came to the United States at the start they were fleeing from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:39.639
    | text      = the Church of England which was basically the same as the Catholic Church to them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.240
    | text      = Over time this anti-Catholic strain would reappear in things like the Klan and the opposition
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:48.519

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = unite the two churches but to increase their understanding of each other.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:07.259
    | text      = You know like all that stuff leads to tension, misunderstanding, stigma.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:11.720
    | text      = So the report stresses that both groups view salvation as God's gift to mankind but it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.360
    | text      = also very clear that they take different approaches.

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
